source.title: USDC Reserve Report as of January 6, 2025 and January 31, 2025
source.http_last_modified_note: HTTP response metadata only. This is not treated as the report publication or signature date.
source.reuse_note: This capture retains an attributed factual extract and source hash, not the report PDF. No reuse license for the report was identified.

method.circulation_criteria: USDC in circulation equals total USDC supply on approved blockchains less tokens allowed but not issued and access-denied tokens.
method.reserve_criteria: Fair value of assets held in the USDC reserve is the total balance of US-dollar-denominated assets in the Circle Reserve Fund and segregated accounts held by Circle with regulated financial institutions on behalf of USDC holders.
method.headroom_calculation: reported reserve fair value in USD minus reported USDC circulation, treating one USDC as the one-dollar comparison unit used by the report
method.publication_scope: The two observations are point-in-time report dates, not daily balances or transfer flows.

attribution: Circle Internet Group, Inc., USDC Reserve Report, report dates January 6 and January 31, 2025, with independent accountants' report dated February 27, 2025. Source URL included above.
limitations: These two attestations establish reported supply, circulation, and reserve snapshots under the stated criteria. They do not establish daily balances, transfer volumes, user adoption, or future reserve sufficiency.
The PDF itself is not included because no report reuse license was identified.
